En habbechor notel pi shenayim bemilve af al pi shehu bishtar af al gav sheggavu karka bechov avihem. haya leav milve beyad habbechor hare ze safek im notel bah pi shenayim hoil veyeshnah tachat yado. o lo yittol hoil umechamat aviv yirashenna vaadayin lo baa leyado shel aviv. lefichach yittol mimmenna chatzi chelek bechora: 
Bechor shemmachar chelek bechora kodem chaluka mimkaro kayyam mippene sheyyesh labbechor chelek bechora kodem chaluka. lefichach im chalak im echav kodem bemiktzat nechasim ben bakkarka ben bemittaltelin venatal chelek kefashut vitter bechol hannechasim veeno notel bisheran ella kefashut. bamme devarim amurim beshello micha. aval im micha beechav veamar bifne shenayim anavim ellu sheani cholek im echay beshave lo mippene shemmachalti bechelek bechora hare ze mechaa velo vitter bishar nechasim. vaafillu micha baanavim keshehen mechubbarim uvetzarum vechillekum beshave lo vitter bishar nechasim. aval im derachum vechalak immahen beshave beyayin velo micha bahen mishshennaasa yayin vitter bishar hannechasim. ha lema ze dome lemi shemmicha baanavim vechalak immahem beshave bazetim shehare vitter bakkol. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi sheyyibbem eshet achiv hu yoresh kol nichse echav hammuchzakim. vechol haruyin lavo leachar mikkan hare hu bahen kechol haachim shehare bechor kara oto hakkatuv shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 6)</small> "vehaya habbechor asher teled yakum al shem achiv hammet velo yimmache shemo miyyisrael". ucheshem sheeno notel mimmennu berauy kivmuchzak kach eno notel bashshevach sheshshavchu nechasim achare mot aviv mishsheat mita ad sheat chalukato im echav benichse aviv. vaafillu hishbichu nechasim achar sheyyibbem vekodem sheyyachleku hare hu bashshevach keechad min haachin. af al pi shennotel min hannechasim ellu shene chalakim chelko vechelek achiv sheyyibbem ishto hoil umet haav bechayye kullan: 
Kevar bearnu behilchot shechenim shehabbechor notel shene chalakim shello keechad bemetzar echad. aval hayyavam shechalak im echav benichse aviv notel chelko vechelek achiv begoral. veim ala goralo bishne mekomot notel bishne mekomot: 
Shomeret yavam shemmeta afillu asa bah echad min haachim maamar mishpachat bet aviha yorshin benichse melog vachatzi nichse tzon barzel. veyorshe habbaal yorshin ketubbatah im chatzi nichse tzon barzel. veyorshe habbaal chayyavin bikvuratah hoil vehen yirshu ketubbatah kemo shebbearnu bimkomo:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 4:
Haomer ze beni o ze achi o ze achi avi o shear hayyorshin oto. af al pi shehoda baanashim sheenan muchzakin shehen kerovav hare ze neeman veyirashennu ben sheamar keshehu bari ben sheamar keshehu shechiv mera. afillu nishtattek vechatav bichtav yado shezze yorsho bodkin oto kederech shebbodkin legittin: 
Hayinu muchzakin baze shehu achiv o ben dodo veamar eno achi veeno ben dodi eno neeman. aval neeman hu al mi shehuchzak shehu beno lomar eno beni velo yirashennu. veyerae li sheafillu hayu labben banim af al pi sheeno neeman alav lomar eno beni leinyan yichus veen machazikin oto mamzer al piv. neeman hu leinyan yerushsha velo yirashennu: 
Haomer ze beni vechazar veamar avdi hu eno neeman. amar avdi vechazar veamar beni af al pi shehu meshammesho keeved neeman shezze sheamar avdi kelomar shehu li keeved. veim hayu korin lo eved ben mea zuz vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sheen omrin otan beyichud ella laavadim hare ze eno neeman: 
Haya over al bet hammeches veamar beni hu ze vechazar achar kach veamar avdi neeman. shello amar beni ella lehaveriach min hammeches. amar bevet hammoches avdi hu vechazar veamar beni hu eno neeman: 
Haavadim vehashshefachot en korin lahen abba peloni veimma pelonit shello yavo min haddavar takkala venimtza ze habben nifgam. lefichach im hayu haavadim vehashshefachot chashuvin beyoter veyesh lahen kol vechol hakkahal makkirin otan veet bene veavde adonehem kegon avde hannasi hare ellu muttar likrot lahen abba veimma: 
Mi shehayta lo shifcha veholid mimmenna ben vehaya noheg bo minhag banim. o sheamar beni hu umeshuchreret hi immo. im talmid chacham hu o adam kasher shehu baduk bedikduke mitzvot hare ze yirashennu. veaf al pi chen eno nose bat yisrael ad sheyyavi reaya shennishtachrera immo veachar kach yalda shehare huchzeka shifcha befanenu. veim mishshear hedyotot hu veen tzarich lomar im haya min hammafkirin atzman lechach hare ze bechezkat eved lechol davar veechav meaviv mochrin oto. veim en leaviv ben chutz mimmennu eshet aviv mityabbemet. veze hu haddin sheyyerae li shehu holech al ikkere hakkabbala. veyesh mi shello chillek ben kesherim lishar haam ella leinyan shello yimkeruhu echav bilvad. veyesh mi shehora sheafillu leyarsho lo nachlok beyisrael veen rauy lismoch al davar ze: 
Kol hayyorshin yorshin bachazaka. ketzad. edim sheheidu shezze muchzak lanu shehu beno shel peloni o achiv. af al pi sheenan ede yichus velo yadu amittat hayyuchasin hare ellu yorshin beedut zo: 
Yaakov shemmet vehinniach reuven veshimon velo huchzak lo ben ella shenehem. tafas reuven levi min hashshuk veamar gam ze achinu hu veshimon omer eni yodea. hare shimon notel chatzi hammamon ureuven shelish shehare hoda shehem shelosha achin velevi notel shetut. met levi yachzor hashshetut liruven. naflu lelevi nechasim acherim yachleku otan reuven veshimon shehare reuven mode leshimon shellevi ze achihen. hishbiach hashshetut meelav veachar kach met levi. im shevach maggia lakketefayim hu kegon anavim shehiggiu lehibbatzer. hare hashshevach hazze kinchasim shennaflu lo meacherim veyachleku bahen. veim adayin lo higgiu lehibbatzer hare hen shel reuven levaddo. amar shimon en levi ze achi venatal levi bechelek reuven kemo shebbearnu veachar kach met levi lo yirash shimon mimmennu kelum ella reuven levaddo yirash hashshetut im shear nechasim acherim shehinniach levi. vehu haddin bechol hayyorshin sheyyodu miktzatan beyorshin acherim shello yodu miktzatan:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 5:
Ze hakkelal beyorshin. kol shene yorshin sheechad mehen yoresh vadday vehashsheni safek en lassafek kelum. veim hayu shenehem safek shemma zehu hayyoresh o shemma ze hayyoresh cholkin beshave. lefichach mi shemmet vehinniach ben vetumtum o anderoginus hare habben yoresh et hakkol shehattumtum vehaanderoginus safek. hinniach banot vetumtum veanderoginus yorshot beshave vahare hu keachat min habbanot: 
Kevar bearnu behilchot ishut din habbanot im habbanim bimzonotehen uvefarnasatan vesham bearnu shehammezonot mittenae ketubba. bizman shehannechasim merubbin en labbanot ella mezonotehen vehabbanim yirshu hakkol veyitparnesu habbanot beissur nechasim kede sheyyinnasu bo levalehen. uvizman shehannechasim muatin en labbanim kelum ella hakkol limzon habbanot. lefichach mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot vetumtum o anderoginus. bizman shehannechasim merubbin habbanim yorshin vedochin hattumtum etzel habbanot venizzon kemotan. uvizman shehannechasin muatin habbanot dochot et hattumtum etzel habbanim veomrot lo zachar atta veen lecha immanu mezonot: 
Mi shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda ben veen yadua im ben tisha lerishon o ben shiva leacharon en ze habben yoresh et echad mishshenehem mippene shehu safek. veim met habben shenehen yorshin oto vecholkin beshave mippene sheshshenehem safek shemma ze aviv o ze aviv: 
Yevama shello shahata shelosha chodashim venityabbema betoch shelosha chodashim veyalda ben veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon. ze hassafek omer shemma ben hammet ani veirash et nichse avi kullan veen atta rauy leyabbem otah sheen immi bat yibbum vehayyavam omer shemma beni atta veimmecha reuya leyabbem veen lecha benichse achi kelum. hoil vegam ze hayyavam safek shemma yavam hu o eno yavam cholkin beshave. vechen din ze hassafek im bene hayyavam benichse hammet shennityabbema ishto cholkin beshave hassafek notel mechetza uvene hayyavam mechetza. met hayyavam achar shechalak im ze hassafek uvau bene hayyavam haruyim lirash avihem af al pi sheyyesh leze hassafek lomar im achichem ani tenu li chelek birushsha zo veim eni achichem hacheziru li hachetzi shellakach avichem en leze hassafek benichse avihen immahen kelum veen motzi miyyadan: 
Safek vehayyavam shebbau lachlok benichse haav hare hayyavam yoresh vadday veze hassafek im hu ben hammet yesh lo chatzi hammamon uleze hayyavam chatzi. veim hu ben hayyavam en lo kelum. lefichach hayyavam yoresh veyiddache hassafek. hinniach hayyavam shene banim vaddain veachar kach met hayyavam hare hassafek omer ani ben hammet veyesh li mechetza velishnechem mechetza vehashshenayim omrim atta achinu uven hayyavam atta veen lecha ella shelish benichse hazzaken hachetzi shemmode lahem bo notlin vehishlish shemmodin hen lo notel vehashshetut hannishar cholkim oto beshave hu notel chetzyo ushenehem chetzyo. met hassafek hare hayyavam omer shemma beni hu vaani irashennu vaavi hayyavam omer shemma ben beni hammet hu vaani irashennu cholkin beshave (met hayyavam hassafek omer beno ani veirashennu vaavi hayyavam omer shemma ben beni haacher atta veze achi avicha hu vaani irashennu cholkin beshave): 
Mi shennafal habbayit alav veal ishto veen yadua im haishsha meta techilla venimtzeu yorshe habbaal yorshin kol nechaseha o habbaal met techilla venimtzeu yorshe haishsha yorshin kol nechaseha ketzad dinam. maamidin nichse melog bechezkat yorshe haishsha vehakketubba ikkar vehattosefet bechezkat yorshe habbaal vecholkin benichse tzon barzel yorshe haishsha notlin chetzyan veyorshe habbaal chetzyan. aval im nafal habbayit alav veal immo maamidin nichse haem bechezkat yorshe haem shehem yorshin vaddain aval yorshe habben safek hem sheim met habben techilla en leechav meaviv benichse imman kelum kemo shebbearnu: 
Nafal habbayit alav veal ben bitto im haav met techilla ben bitto yirashennu venimtzeu hannechasim shel yorshe habben. veim ben bitto met techilla en habben yoresh et immo bakkever kemo shebbearnu venimtzeu hannechasim shel yorshe haav. lefichach yachleku yorshe haav im yorshe ben habbat. vechen im [nishba] haav umet ben bitto bammedina o shennishba habben umet avi immo bammedina yachleku yorshe haav im yorshe ben habbat: 
Nafal alav habbayit veal aviv o shear morishin vealav ketubbat ishsha uvaale chov. yorshe haav omrin met habben techilla velo hinniach kelum veavad hachov uvaale chovot omrim haav met techilla vezacha habben birushshato veyesh lanu ligbot mechelko. hare hannechasim bechezkat hayyorshin veal haishsha uvaale chovot lehavi reaya o yelchu lahem belo kelum: 
Din ellu shemmetu tachat hammappolet. o shettavu bayyam. o shennaflu laesh. o shemmetu beyom echad veze bimdina zo vehaacher bimdina acheret. din echad hu. shebbechol ellu vechayyotze bahen en yodin mi hu shemmet techilla:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 6: En adam yachol lehorish lemi sheeno rauy leyarsho velo laakor hayerushsha min hayyoresh af al pi shezze mamon hu. lefi shenneemar befarashat nechalot <small>(Bamidbar 27 11)</small> "vehayta livne yisrael lechukkat mishpat" lomar shechukka zo lo nishtanna veen hattenay moil bah. ben shetztzivva vehu bari ben shehaya shechiv mera ben al pe ben bichtav eno moil:

Lefichach haomer ish peloni beni bechori lo yittol pi shenayim. ish peloni beni lo yirash im echav. lo amar kelum. ish peloni yirasheni bemakom sheyyesh lo bat. bitti tirasheni bemakom sheyyesh lo ben. lo amar kelum. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval hayu lo yorshin rabbim kegon banim rabbim o achim o banot veamar keshehu shechiv mera peloni achi yirasheni mikkelal echay o bitti pelonit tirasheni mikkelal benotay devarav kayyamin ben sheamar al pe ben shekkatav bichtav. aval im amar peloni beni yirasheni levaddo im amar al pe devarav kayyamin. aval im katav kol nechasav livno lo asahu ella appotroppos kemo shebbearnu:

Amar peloni beni yirash chatzi nechasay ushear banay hachetzi devarav kayyamin. aval im amar habbechor yirash kappashut o sheamar lo yirash pi shenayim im echav lo amar kelum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 16)</small> "lo yuchal levakker et ben haahuva al pene ven hassenua habbechor" <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "ki et habbechor ben hassenua yakkir":
Veim haya bari eno yachol lehosif velo ligroa lo labbechor velo leechad mishshear hayyorshin:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheamar bilshon yerushsha. aval im natan mattana devarav kayyamin. lefichach hamechallek nechasav al piv levanav keshehu shechiv mera ribba leechad umiet leechad vehishva lahen habbechor devarav kayyamin. veim amar mishshum yerushsha lo amar kelum:

Katav ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof mishshum mattana af al pi shehizkir leshon yerushsha battechilla uvassof devarav kayyamin. ketzad. tinnaten sade peloni lifloni beni veyirashenna. o sheamar yirashenna vetinnaten lo veyirashenna. o yirashenna vetinnaten lo. hoil veyesh sham leshon mattana af al pi shehizkir leshon yerushsha battechilla uvassof devarav kayyamin. vechen im hayu shalosh sadot lishlosha yorshin veamar yirash peloni sade pelonit vetinnaten lifloni sade pelonit veyirash peloni sade pelonit kanu. af al pi shezze sheamar lo bilshon yerushsha eno ze sheamar lo bilshon mattana. vehu shello yishhe ben amira laamira kede dibbur. aval im shaha tzarich sheyyehe leshon hammattana meorav bishlashtan:

Ketzad. im haya leshon hammattana baemtza yomar peloni ufeloni ufeloni yirshu sade peloni ufeloni ufeloni shennetattim lahen bemattana veyirashum. veim haya leshon hammattana battechilla yomar tinnaten sade peloni ufeloni ufeloni lifloni ufeloni ufeloni veyirashum. veim haya leshon hammattana bassof yomar yirash peloni ufeloni ufeloni sade peloni ufeloni ufeloni shennetattim lahen bemattana:
Yerushshat habbaal af al pi shehi middivrehem asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora. veen hattenay moil bah ella im ken hitna immah keshehi arusa kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut:
Haakkum yoresh et aviv devar tora. aval shear yerushshotehen mannichin oto lefi minhagam:

Vehagger eno yoresh et aviv haakkum ella middivrehem tikkenu lo sheyyirash keshehaya shemma yachzor lemirdo. veyerae li shettenay moil birushsha zo hoil veen haakkum mechuyyav laamod betakkanat chachamim. veen haakkum yoresh et aviv hagger velo ger yoresh et ger lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim:

Kol hannoten nechasav laacherim vehinniach hayyorshin. af al pi sheen hayyorshin nohagin (bo) kashshura en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. vezachu haacherim bechol ma shennatan lahen. middat chasidut hi shello yaid adam chasid betzavvaa shemmaavirin bo hayerushsha min hayyoresh afillu mibben sheeno noheg kashshura leachiv chacham venoheg kashshura:

Yisrael shehemir yoresh et kerovav hayyisreelim keshehaya. veim rau bet din leabbed et mamono ulekanso shello yirash kede shello lechazzek et yedehem harshut beyadan. veim yesh lo banim beyisrael tinnaten yerushshat avihen hammumar lahen. vechen hamminhag tamid bammaarav:
Tziuu chachamim shello yeshanne adam ben habbanim bechayyav afillu bedavar muat shello yavou lide tacharut vekina kaache yosef im yosef:
